carmen: SCIM started failing after yesterday's RBAC rename + KMS rotate. Seeing InvalidCiphertextException in provisioner logs for some extids.
mira: can you paste a log sample?
carmen: `2026-03-18T15:02:09Z ERROR scim: InvalidCiphertextException: Unable to decrypt extid`
sam: that means the DB ciphertext was encrypted with the old key alias. Did rotation delete old key?
olivia: we renamed roles (team:eng:platform -> team:platform) at the same time; mappings may be out of sync.
mira: quick mitigation: deploy a permissive-match mode to avoid mass deprovision (match on email + last_login window). Pushing canary now.
carmen: ops — can we cancel deletion on old KMS key if it's pending?
idp-bot: ALERT: SCIM provisioner error rate 5.9% (threshold 5%).
ops-bot: old key is pending deletion (6 days left). Can cancel if approved. Ticket PROD-1159 opened.
sam: plan: 1) cancel deletion, 2) give scim role decrypt rights, 3) run re-encrypt job to migrate extids to new key, 4) roll back permissive-match flag.
mira: added `--scim-permissive-match` and canary error rate dropped to ~1%.
olivia: post-incident: add runbook step to verify DB re-encrypt targets before KMS rotate, and smoke test RBAC rename + SCIM.
carmen: noted. I'll monitor re-encrypt batches and keep alert open for 30m.
